text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's the day of the Fillies' 
Revue... the stands are buzzing with talk 
about Vodka and Daiwa Scarlet's clash in 
the Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Aston Machan smiles fearlessly. 
"Things are... getting exciting." And so, 
she headed out to the race all on her own!
